title: Dead man switch set up in first call with Jeremy Corbell

tellings.quote: I told the very first conversation I had with Jeremy. I said, "Jeremy, I don't know you. You don't know me. I'm going to go become a congressional whistleblower.

plain: Dylan Borland says that in his very first phone call with a man named Jeremy Corbell, he set up a dead man switch, an arrangement for what he knows to come out if something happens to him. Borland tells Michels he opened that call by saying, "Jeremy, I don't know you. You don't know me. I'm going to go become a congressional whistleblower." He tells it to show how seriously he took the risk of speaking to Congress, and that he felt he needed protection from the start.
